resources.title: The Last Museum
resources.description: Search and browse over 6.3 million artworks across human history—from 3000 BC to the present—with timeline filtering and high-resolution museum plates.
resources.notes: Great for exploring art history chronologically or searching by subject, artist, or era.

resources.title: Neal.fun
resources.description: Interactive micro-games, playful simulations, and visual web experiments by Neal Agarwal—from Infinite Craft and The Password Game to exploring the deep sea and outer space.
resources.notes: Great for kids and family browsing; standout experiments include Infinite Craft, The Deep Sea, The Size of Space, Internet Artifacts, and The Password Game.

resources.title: Hacker Books
resources.description: Search and browse over 16,000 books mentioned across Hacker News comment threads since 2007, ranked by distinct recommendations, rising trends, and 29 subject categories.
resources.notes: Links every book directly to the original Hacker News comment threads where readers discussed or recommended it—great for finding deeply vetted computing, science, history, and sci-fi reads.

resources.title: F/OSS Comics
resources.description: Illustrated comic series exploring the history of computing, Unix, and free and open-source software—from Bell Labs and Dennis Ritchie to BSD Unix and the birth of the vi editor.
resources.notes: Approachable visual storytelling that makes operating-system history, the Unix philosophy, and classic software engineering accessible for both older kids and adults.
